forum.title: B-U585I-IOT02A: No ADC1 data from PC0 pin
forum.category: STM32 MCUs Boards and hardware tools
forum.best_answer_content:
Rubber ducking success!!

After re-reading my own post here, and playing around with the CubeMX settings for the ADC, I finally got it to work.

![EmbeddedN00b_0-1778664790306.png](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/f3846862-9fa1-d313-852c-65839f99bf34.png "EmbeddedN00b_0-1778664790306.png")

After changing "Enable Regular Conversions" to Enable, it magically started to work.

![EmbeddedN00b_1-1778664834899.png](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/69675008-fe81-f25e-18e4-932b42dcb4e7.png "EmbeddedN00b_1-1778664834899.png")

But... I do not now know why.....
